name: gizza-ai/ioc-extract
summary: Extract IOCs (IPs, URLs, domains, emails, hashes) from text.

tool.description: Extract indicators of compromise (IOCs) from an arbitrary block of text — IPv4/IPv6 addresses, URLs, domains, emails, and MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 hashes — de-duplicated, sorted and grouped by type. Recognizes and refangs defanged input; can optionally re-defang the output.
